dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: #"The Marechaussee Hunter's skills hadn't dulled with time. Nimbly {M#he}{F#she} leapt from the bushes and delivered a mighty blow to the enemy's head with {M#his}{F#her} frying pan."

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: "Though the frying pan might be ordinary, the Marechaussee Hunter was no ordinary Chef. The enemy let out a grunt before collapsing completely."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: N—Nice! Okay. Next, I'll... Right. Gotta use "Swift as Wind" to close the distance, then use "Four Elements Strike" from behind...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *sigh* That didn't work at all! Ugh, okay, whatever, the monsters are charging at me anyway. I'll just stand, plant, and blow 'em away with "Four Elements Strike"...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ack! That hurts! Ugh, who bit my leg... Huh, Ashru, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ah...! I—Is it this late already!? Oh no, oh no, I completely forgot the task that Boss Nef asked me to handle!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I—I'm sorry, I—I—I can't play right now—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ashru, wait for me! Hey, why are you running off so fast!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Well... It seems we'll have to end our game here for today.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Navia, put the monster sign back where it was, I saw that.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Well... *chuckle* That's quite a long story.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: If we get the chance, we can sit down and discuss it in detail.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hmm. Actually, didn't Illuga say he wanted to invite a colleague to play with us?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Since this game's paused anyway, why don't we take this chance to go find him? The more people we have, the more fun we'll have!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Mr. Flins? He... Uh... Yeah, I'm sure he'll play with us if we go look for him...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Ah, that's perfect! Come on, let's go buy him some gifts first, and then pay him a visit in person.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we'll let you know once we're ready.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: When the time comes, you have to continue the adventure with us.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If you call, I shall answer.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: That's my trusty companion for you! Now, let's go pay Mr. Flins a visit... Hmm... What kind of gift should we get him?

choices.text: Why did you come all the way here to play "Tabletop Troupe"?
